finding.claim: The /logo handler fetches an attacker-supplied URL. Its only check is a substring match for "example.io", so any URL containing that text anywhere (query, fragment, path) is fetched, including internal and link-local addresses. The default client also follows redirects, so a trusted-looking URL can bounce to an internal target. The response body is copied back to the attacker, so the SSRF is non-blind.
finding.source: main.go:31 raw := r.FormValue("logo") -- the "logo" query or form parameter, supplied by any unauthenticated HTTP client (the server listens on :8081, main.go:44, with no auth).
finding.sink: main.go:36 http.Get(raw) using http.DefaultClient, with the response streamed back via io.Copy(w, resp.Body) at main.go:38.

trace.note: /logo is registered on the default mux, reachable without auth.
raw is read directly from the request via FormValue, so it is fully attacker-controlled. The string is never parsed as a URL before the check.

Validation is strings.Contains(raw, "example.io"). It is not a hostname check. A URL such as http://10.0.0.5/?example.io or http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/?example.io passes, because the marker sits in the query string, while the request goes to the internal host.

http.Get(raw) parses raw itself. It accepts any http or https scheme and any host or IP, with no private-address or loopback block. Redirects are followed (up to 10 by default), so a host that passes the check can 30x-redirect to an internal address.
io.Copy streams the internal response body to the requester, so the attacker reads the target's content directly.

finding.guards_checked: Only the strings.Contains check at main.go:32. There is no url.Parse, no Hostname comparison, no scheme allow-list, no IP-range denylist, no DNS pinning, no redirect restriction (the client at line 36 is the default, not the noRedirect-configured client used in cdn()), and no timeout. The substring check does not constrain the destination host at all.

verdict.guard_found: none. The only check is strings.Contains(raw, "example.io") at main.go:32, a substring match that does not constrain the parsed host. No url.Parse, hostname comparison, scheme restriction, IP denylist, or redirect restriction exists on the /logo path. Line 36 uses the default http.Get, which follows redirects.
verdict.reason: The attacker-controlled value at main.go:31 (r.FormValue("logo")) reaches http.Get at main.go:36 after only the substring check at main.go:32, so a URL like http://10.0.0.5/?example.io passes and the internal response is streamed back via io.Copy at main.go:38; the handler is registered without auth at main.go:43 on :8081 (main.go:44). Every trace line checked matches the code. The unrelated trusted-host check on /cdn (main.go:20) does not apply to this handler.
